integrity: The exact finite formula and asymptotic constant are proved analytically; finite exact enumeration is only a cross-check. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact sign for isolated-vertex counts in complete bipartite random graphs; sparse limit requires both class sizes and sampled edge count proportional to n. Earlier equivalent presentation cannot be excluded by limited source coverage.
title: Isolation covariance reverses sign across three bipartite edge-sampling ensembles
